# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 17 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 17:1 — "enlightened my face" vs. "made my face shine" vs. "lit up my face"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "enlightened my face" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "made my face shine" | Idiomatic |
| PNEUMA | "lit up my face" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "enlightened my face" -- preserves the knowledge connotation.
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 17:8 — "broken vessel" vs. "shattered vessel" vs. "shattered pot"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "broken vessel" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "shattered vessel" | More emphatic |
| PNEUMA | "shattered pot" | Colloquial |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "broken vessel" -- biblical idiom (Ps 31:13).
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 17:9 — melitzei kazav: "interpreters of lies" vs. "interpreters of falsehood" vs. "spinners of lies"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "interpreters of lies" | Standard Qumran term |
| LOGOS | "interpreters of falsehood" | Formal variant |
| PNEUMA | "spinners of lies" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "interpreters of lies" -- standard scholarly rendering.
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 17:11 — chalaqot: "smooth things" vs. "flattery" vs. "easy words"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "smooth things" | Technical term preserving wordplay |
| LOGOS | "flattery" | English equivalent |
| PNEUMA | "easy words" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "smooth things" -- key Qumran sectarian term.
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 17:17 — "double heart" vs. "divided heart" vs. "split heart"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "double heart" | Literal: lev va-lev |
| LOGOS | "divided heart" | Interpretive |
| PNEUMA | "split heart" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "double heart" -- captures the duplicity.
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 17:18 — "poison and wormwood" vs. "venom and wormwood" vs. "poison and bitterness"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "poison and wormwood" | Literal (Deut 29:17) |
| LOGOS | "venom and wormwood" | Variant |
| PNEUMA | "poison and bitterness" | Loses plant name |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "poison and wormwood" -- preserves Deuteronomy 29:17 allusion.
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 17:29 — "cut off" vs. "destroy" vs. "wipe out"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "cut off" | Literal: karat -- covenantal term |
| LOGOS | "destroy" | Generic |
| PNEUMA | "wipe out" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "cut off" -- karat carries specific covenantal weight.
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 17:33 — "hold fast" vs. "cling" vs. "hold on"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "hold fast to You" | Literal, formal |
| LOGOS | "cling to You" | Biblical (devekut) |
| PNEUMA | "hold on to You" | Casual |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "hold fast to You" -- more dignified.
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

**Total disagreements for Column 17:** 8
